title: Question 3.2: StopWordsRemover
instruction: Not all words are equally important when analyzing text. This code removes words that don't carry much meaning.
reveal: StopWordsRemover removes common words like "the", "a", "and", "is", "in", etc. These words appear in almost every sentence but don't help distinguish between positive and negative reviews. By removing them, we focus on words that actually matter for sentiment analysis. The filtered words go into a new column called "filtered_words".
